shots.detail_en: CH slams three giant paper order slips onto the counter as the opening bell rings, his fountain-pen signature striking through the paper.
shots.sub: 联华实业——今天起，我买。明牌。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED looks up behind the counter as MANCANG squeezes in clutching a cup of soy milk.
shots.sub: 三张大单，一张比一张狠。／疯了——跟熊家明牌对轰！
shots.speaker: RED+MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Extreme wide of the mechanical flip board where the Lianhua Industrial row erupts in alternating red and green arrows above the boiling hall.
shots.sub: 公开狙击。我把自己挂上靶子——只为请熊家出洞。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Crowd layers close in until the counter becomes an island, one retail trader on tiptoe and another holding his pager high overhead.
shots.sub: 扫地工要打熊家？！／我 BP 机都举起来了！
shots.speaker: 散户甲+散户乙

shots.detail_en: MANCANG jumps onto a bench and plays the narrator for the crowd.
shots.sub: 各位散户兄弟——今天，全仓跟长虹哥走！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Four-beat rapid cuts: Xiong-family orders slamming back / the board flipping green / CH adding orders / flipping red again in a red-green crossfire.
shots.sub: 盘口会说谎，成交量不会——他的护盘钱，正一寸寸现身。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH studies the order flow, knuckles tapping a slow rhythm on the desk.
shots.sub: 护盘的单子每三笔，有一笔绕路——路，是旧的。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED audits the settlement flow behind the counter, fingertip stopping dead on one column of data.
shots.sub: 这条资金路径……老账本里，走过同一圈。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED scribbles a note and slips it into CH's palm under cover of handing back a trade receipt.
shots.sub: 护盘的单子全绕老路走——过了两点，他们会换路。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH unfolds the note, folds it again and presses it into the front page of his father's notebook.
shots.sub: 账房的眼睛，比大屏亮。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG sips tea unhurried on the second-floor VIP seats, his binoculars left untouched on the table.
shots.sub: 小孩子的游戏——翻不了牌。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Montage of the big board: Lianhua Industrial's red bars topping one after another as the hall's gasps rise wave upon wave.
shots.sub: 拉了拉了！真拉了！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: XIONG's teacup stops at his lip, one eyebrow lifting for the very first time.
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONG sets down the teacup, rises, and for the first time walks to the second-floor railing to look down over the hall.
The prayer beads on XIONG's wrist stop mid-turn, his gaze nailed to the white shirt down on the floor.
shots.sub: 这个建仓手法……不学自通。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH looks up through the streaming crowd and meets XIONG's gaze at the railing — their first standoff across the hall.
shots.sub: 爸——他站起来了。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's pager buzzes like mad as he holds back the surging crowd with both arms.
shots.sub: 都别动！长虹哥说了——不见量，不落单！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Closing flurry: paper slips flying / one last red-green crossfire / the closing hammer falling.
shots.sub: 收盘——联华实业，涨四分一！
shots.speaker: 经纪

shots.detail_en: The crowd gone, CH squares the day's trade slips into one tidy stack.
shots.sub: 第一回合——只探出他一只手。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: At night in the Xiong study, XIONG stares at the old 1993 group photo on the wall.
shots.sub: 像。太像了——像到不像巧合。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI calls in from an overseas office over the video line, data streams reflected on his rimless glasses.
shots.sub: 爸。他的单子路径——和 93 年那批数据，同源。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.card: 同源的手法——十年前，教他的人已经不在了。
